title: Eh...
text: Eh.... This is just OK. I don't like the way it fits in the base. Anytime something is engineered like that there is a weakness and a wobble.  This will work OK if you have tiny cups or small mugs. The way the hooks are laid out doesn't allow for a larger mug to hang on all the hooks without banging into whatever is hanging above or below it.
